verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own API, which powers Embedded Accounting and was built for platform-to-platform integrations, plus an MCP connection that gives Claude access to account financial data. Nothing shows the API matches the UI: the docs frame it around partner integrations, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: a documented API reference with endpoint coverage, evidence of write operations matching UI actions (invoices, journal entries, reconciliation, AI Close, rules), self-serve API access for individual users, and independent confirmation of API/UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With Puzzle's Embedded Accounting—powered by our API, your platform gets automated AI bookkeeping, real-time financial insights, and a clean data foundation built to scale
Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation
